summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes are in rich/progress.py (private _FileReader and _FileContext classes, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads), tests/test_progress.py (25 new tests before the __main__ block), docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections), and CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased Added bullet for PR 1759). Nothing is committed and nothing was run: tests, mypy, and Python were not executed, so the work is verified by reading only. Next step: run pytest tests/test_progress.py and mypy. Open risks: mypy suppression codes were mapped from the spec's category names; the module-level open return has no suppression, since the context wrapper is typed as Any; and on Python 3.6 the reader's BinaryIO base may make mode and name abstract.
